### **Job Description and Duties**


**Per CCR 249\.3, this job control may be used to fill subsequent vacancies.**  

**This is a 12\-month Limited Term (LT) position that may be extended up to 24 months or may become permanent.**  

Under the direction of the Environmental Program Manager I (Supervisory), the Senior Environmental Scientist Specialist (SES Spec) leads the coordination of activities of ERIHC from within the NS\&C Program. The SES (Spec) is the program lead, responsible for ensuring that the program commitments are met. The SES will provide technical coordination and training to CACs, administrative support staff, collaborating agencies, and other contractors related to the program’s commitments and objectives. The SES (Spec) must also establish effective working relationships and maintain cooperative liaison relationships with government agencies, agricultural industry, and the general public. This position is necessary to provide technical support to CACs and facilitate interagency coordination for addressing non\-compliant hemp cultivation activities.  

As an employee of the California Department of Food \& Agriculture (CDFA), you are required to perform the “essential functions” of the job, with or without reasonable accommodation. If you are interested in becoming part of a diverse and inclusive workforce where talent, experience, and expertise are valued, then CDFA is the place for you!!  

This CDFA work location is near restaurants, coffee shops, and a farmer’s market. We are within walking distance to light rail/public transportation, across the street from beautiful Capitol Park, and two miles from Downtown Commons (DOCO).  

This position is not eligible for visa sponsorship. Applicants must be authorized to work in the United States. The CDFA does not participate in E\-Verify for employment authorization purposes.  

You will find additional information about the job in the **Duty Statement**.


### **Working Conditions**


The duties of this job are performed indoors approximately ninety percent (90%) of the time in an office. The employee’s workstation is located inside an office building equipped with standard office equipment. The remainder of the time is spent traveling to meetings or district offices, outdoor locations, warehouses or facilities of industrial hemp production or sale. The employee may be exposed to extremes in temperature, dust, fumes, gases, and odors.  

  

Overnight and/or extended travel to various locations throughout the State may be required to accomplish work objectives in various environments. State vehicles are used to travel to these worksites. Rental vehicles and/or air travel may also be used.  

This position may/may not be eligible for telework. The amount of telework is at the discretion of the CDFA and based on the current telework policy. While the CDFA supports telework where possible, in\-person attendance may be required based on operational needs. Employees are expected to be able to report to their worksite with minimal notification if an urgent need arises, as determined by the Department.

The Mission of the California Department of Food and Agriculture (CDFA) is to safeguard a resilient food system and promote an equitable marketplace, cultivating a California grown food supply that is globally recognized for innovation, quality, and sustainability.  


  

As part of the Pest Exclusion Branch, the Nursery, Seed, and Cotton Program (NS\&C) is responsible for the enforcement of laws and regulations that ensure the quality and orderly marketing of nursery, seed, and cotton plant products. ### **Job Description and Duties**


Under general direction of the Research Data Supervisor II, incumbent serves as an analyst for supporting the various data\-related projects for the Office of Health Workforce Development (OHWD). This position supports the development of reports summarizing outcomes and, when required, presents the information to executive leadership or decision\-making bodies. The incumbent has knowledge of data provisioning, validation, testing, standardization, reporting/dissemination, and application scoring criteria. Provides consultative services regarding healthcare workforce programs and their impacts, as well as the healthcare workforce industry. Utilizes a variety of software packages to conduct research, perform data analyses, and create data visualizations, including but not limited to Tableau, Qualtrics, ArcGIS, Excel, Power BI, R, Python, Microsoft Dynamics and PowerPoint. Analyzes qualitative and quantitative data and understands survey design, as well as best practices for a variety of data collection and reporting processes. Works with OHWD management, departmental staff, legislative bodies, governmental entities, commissions, partners, stakeholders, and other customers and serves on healthcare workforce planning advisory bodies, ad hoc groups, and other work teams to ensure research is relevant and accurate.

jobs.title: Project Level Environmental Geologist / Scientist
jobs.description:
**Employment Opportunity:** 

**Project Level Environmental Geologist / Scientist**   
**Weber, Hayes \& Associates** 

Our well\-established Monterey Bay\-located environmental consulting firm (www.weber\-hayes.com) is seeking a full time Project Level Geologist/Scientist for a mix of project management, field work, reporting and technical support related to range of environmental investigation, remediation, and compliance services. Our firm completes agency\-required evaluations needed to assess chemical releases (groundwater, soil and soil vapor), drinking water supply, stormwater and other regulated environmental compliance investigations for a wide range of clients. The ideal candidate is an intelligent, motivated, and detail\-oriented team player who is at least 2 to 4 years into their career as an environmental geologist / scientist. If you are seeking employment with a small firm where you are valued and can choose your career path with our support as you learn what excites you, then please apply.

The primary focus of this position will be to collaborate with and support geologists/engineers with all aspects of project management, budgeting, planning, field data collection, and compilation of technical reports. Work would involve interfacing with our staff, clients, and regulatory agencies from the local to State levels. Candidate qualification considerations include:

* BS degree in Geology, Environmental Science or another related technical field.
* 40\-Hour HAZWOPER Training.
* Other beneficial (but not required) certifications include, Geologist\-in\-Training, Stormwater QSD/QSP/QISD/QISP, and/or Professional Registration.

The job will include a broad mix of field and office work – the candidate must:

* Possess basic knowledge of contaminant fate and transport in environmental media, environmental sampling techniques and remediation technologies.
* Have familiarity with laboratory analytical methods for typical contaminants of concern found in environmental media.
* Possess strong technical writing and oral communication skills and able to meet schedule deadlines.
* Have proficiency with standard word processing and database programs (Microsoft Word/Excel/Power Point, Adobe Acrobat, etc.).
* Have the ability to read, interpret and apply information on State and Federal technical guidance, and regulations, and compliance determinations.
* Be self\-motivated and self\-directed, able\-bodied, and hardworking (ability to stoop, kneel, climb, lift up to 50 pounds, and working occasional long days).
* Have a valid, current California Driver’s License, and,
* Have 2\-4 years\-experience in a related field.
* This position requires relocation to the Monterey Bay Area and regular in\-office attendance

GENERAL PROJECT GEOLOGIST / SCIENTIST RESPONSIBILITIES AND DUTIES

* Design environmental field investigations and prepare technical documents including work plans, site assessment reports, feasibility studies, and remedial action plans.
* Manage multiple projects at any one given time, including the preparation and management of project budgets, meeting project deadlines, and ensuring effective client and regulatory agency communication and relation.
* Perform a wide range of fieldwork tasks, including subcontractor management, logging soil borings, overseeing groundwater monitoring / remediation well installations, UST removals, remedial excavations, and collecting soil, groundwater, surface water, soil vapor and indoor air samples, as well as documenting field activities.
* Set up field projects, including permitting, hiring subcontractors; coordinating with staff, laboratories, and subcontractors; and obtaining necessary materials and equipment.
* Perform data management, review, and synthesis.
* Prepare technical reports documenting fieldwork and results.
* Willingness to travel to project sites throughout central California.
* Maintain a positive attitude and be a team player.

COMPENSATION

Annual salary starts at $82K to $92K based on experience and pay increases are based on performance. This position includes medical, dental and prescription plan health benefits, profit\-sharing bonuses (typically no less than $15\-20K per year), and 401(k) plan with employer match. Other benefits include ten (10\) paid holidays per year, paid vacation time, and use of a company vehicle. This career\-based position will naturally progress into a Senior Geologist / Scientist role and beyond, with the right applicant.

Pay: $97,000\.00 \- $112,000\.00 per year

jobs.title: Experienced Environmental Consultant
jobs.description:
Experienced Environmental Consultant  
IAQ, Mold, Asbestos, Lead, VOCs, Fire \& Industrial Hygiene

**Air Quality Testers (AQT)**  
**Northern California / San Francisco Bay Area**  
**Flexible Part\-Time to Full\-Time**  
**W\-2, Non\-Exempt Field Position**

**Compensation**  
Estimated total compensation: $40–$70 per hour equivalent  
Base pay: $22 per hour for all hours worked  
\+ 15% uncapped personal sales commission  
\+ separate mileage, parking, and toll reimbursement

The advertised **$40–$70\+ per hour range** reflects estimated total hourly\-equivalent compensation based on individual sales performance, collected revenue, hours worked, project availability, and productivity.

Commission is earned on qualifying collected service revenue from projects personally closed by the consultant under AQT’s written commission plan. There is no maximum commission limit.

**Commission Examples**  
Monthly qualifying revenue  
15% commission  
$20,000 **$3,000**  
$25,000 **$3,750**  
$35,000 **$5,250**  
$50,000 **$7,500**

Commission is paid in addition to hourly wages.

**Position Highlights**

* **15% uncapped personal sales commission**
* **Company\-provided leads**
* **Paid certifications and renewals**
* **Company\-provided testing equipment and PPE**
* **Mileage, parking, and toll reimbursement**
* **Flexible part\-time to full\-time availability**
* **Career advancement into senior consulting and project management**
* **Company\-vehicle eligibility for qualifying top performers**

**About Air Quality Testers**

Air Quality Testers is an independent environmental consulting firm specializing in science\-based environmental testing, building investigations, and indoor environmental assessments.

AQT performs third\-party testing and consulting and does not perform remediation. This allows our consultants to provide clients with objective findings and independent recommendations.

**Our services include:**

* Mold and moisture assessments
* Indoor air quality testing
* VOC and formaldehyde testing
* Asbestos inspections and sampling
* Lead inspections and testing
* Fire and smoke contamination assessments
* Industrial hygiene services
* Allergen testing
* Water and soil testing
* Post\-remediation verification
* Building\-related environmental consulting

**The Opportunity**

We are seeking an experienced and certified Environmental Consultant who is comfortable managing the full client experience from the initial consultation and project sale through inspection, sampling, documentation, and final recommendations.

AQT provides inbound client opportunities, environmental testing equipment, personal protective equipment, laboratory coordination, operational support, and report\-production assistance.

This position is designed for a consultant who wants the flexibility of a part\-time to full\-time schedule, hourly security, and significant commission\-based earning potential.

Consultants who provide excellent service, close more projects, and appropriately expand project scopes can substantially increase their earnings.

**Primary Responsibilities**

* Consult with inbound residential and commercial clients
* Understand client concerns and recommend appropriate environmental testing
* Develop project scopes, pricing, and sampling plans
* Close assigned client opportunities
* Schedule and confirm projects
* Identify appropriate additional testing when site conditions support it
* Perform environmental inspections and sample collection
* Conduct moisture, infrared, and visual building assessments
* Inspect attics, crawlspaces, and other accessible building areas when safe
* Document observations through photographs, videos, and detailed field notes
* Complete chain\-of\-custody and laboratory documentation
* Maintain accurate project, CRM, and timekeeping records
* Communicate preliminary observations professionally without overstating findings
* Review laboratory results and report drafts
* Add project\-specific findings, recommendations, and corrections
* Coordinate with AQT’s report\-writing and quality\-assurance team
* Maintain and protect company equipment
* Follow company safety, ethical, and quality\-control procedures

**Hourly Compensation**

The consultant is paid hourly for all compensable work, including:

* Client consultations and sales calls
* Follow\-up communication
* Compensable business travel
* Inspections and sampling
* Laboratory drop\-offs
* Equipment and supply stops
* Field documentation
* Report review and recommendations
* Meetings and training
* Required administrative work

Consultants using an approved personal vehicle for authorized company business receive separate mileage reimbursement, plus reimbursement for approved parking and tolls.

**Commission Compensation**

The consultant earns:

15% of qualifying collected AQT service revenue from projects personally closed by the consultant.

The written commission agreement will explain:

* What qualifies as personally closed revenue
* When commission is earned
* When commission is paid
* Client payment requirements
* Cancellations and refunds
* Shared projects
* Onsite additions
* Adjustments and employment termination

Commission is uncapped, meaning there is no maximum amount the consultant can earn from qualifying revenue.

**Required Qualifications**

* Currently holds at least one relevant environmental, indoor\-air\-quality, mold, asbestos, lead, industrial\-hygiene, or building\-science certification
* Professional experience performing environmental inspections, testing, sampling, or building assessments
* Strong client\-consultation and sales\-closing ability
* Ability to develop appropriate testing scopes and sampling plans
* Strong technical documentation and report\-review skills
* Ability to explain technical information clearly and professionally
* Strong attention to detail and commitment to objective consulting
* Ability to work independently in residential and commercial environments
*

Description:

The Oneida ESC Group is a family of companies owned by the Oneida Nation of Wisconsin that delivers customer\-focused engineering, science, and construction services worldwide.


Our family of companies include: Oneida ESC Group (OESC), Oneida Total Integrated Enterprises (OTIE), Mission Support Services (MS2\), Sustainment \& Restoration Services (SRS) and Oneida Engineering Solutions (OES). We integrate our staff for dedicated, cooperative, and business\-like delivery of services to enhance our customers’ missions.


Sustainment \& Restoration Services (SRS) is a Small Business that provides engineering, science, construction, munitions, and specialized professional services solutions for customers nationwide.

**SRS** has an immediate opening for **Field Geologist/Field Team Lead (FTL)/Site Safety and Health Officer (SSHO)** in our **Santa Barbara or Ventura offices.** Full\-time position in the Santa Barbara or Ventura offices, working primarily in California.

**Field Events Planning, Data Collection, Subcontractor Oversight**

* Review and understanding of all relevant work plans and health \& safety plans prior to initiating field work.
* Responsible for field work preparation including ensuring all necessary subcontracts are in place, all materials and equipment are in hand, and any training or reviews are completed before hand.
* Fulfillment of data quality objectives (DQOs) for all field collected data and samples; responsible for data quality during pre\-field preparations, field work execution, sample management, and documentation.
* Supervision of drilling and well installations, including all documentation.
* Lithologic/soil descriptions per standard references.
* Soil, groundwater, sediment, surface water, air, and waste characterization sampling per established protocols and approved sampling and analysis plans.
* Complete all required field documentation either via tablet or legible handwritten field sheets; provide to project manager or archive as directed.
* Perform routine operation and maintenance tasks on remedial equipment up to level of experience and competency under direction of supervising engineer and assist in trouble\-shooting and preventative maintenance.
* Self\-perform or oversee remediation projects, which may include injection of emulsified vegetable oil, chemical oxidants, or other injectable materials.

**Data Evaluations/Reports (under Senior Technical Supervision)**

* Support development and refinement of conceptual site models per established project objectives and approved work plans.
* Research and develop accurate and relevant descriptions of site geology and hydrogeology, including geologic/hydrogeologic/geochemical/biological/etc. controls on contaminant fate and transport.
* Develop groundwater elevation contour maps, estimate gradients (horizontal, vertical), flow directions, including analytical and digital modeling.
* Evaluate potential receptors (surface water, extraction/production wells, human, ecological) to contaminated groundwater, soil vapor.
* Evaluate fate and transport of chemicals of concern.
* Produce data visualization products (work with CADD/GIS on products).

**Project Support**

* Provide project management support such as tracking schedules, preparing routine progress reports.
* Support project procurement activities including developing subcontractor scopes of work, researching subcontractors, pricing, tracking status of bids, and coordinating with contract manager.


Requirements:
**Qualification Requirements**

* BS or MS in geological sciences; 3\-5 years of collective experience
* Excellent computer skills in Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, PowerPoint, SharePoint.
* Good communication skills, verbal and written.
* Able to work independently and as part of a team
* Willing to travel on projects throughout the United States; generally not more than 2 weeks at a time.
* Must be able to pass Federal Background Check in order to gain access to project sites
* Must be able to pass DMV check and maintain acceptable driving record

**Preferred Qualifications**

* Professional Geologist (PG) license obtained or on track to obtain.

**Benefits:**

* 16 Days of Paid Time Off
* 8 Paid Holidays
* 401(k) Retirement Plan with Company Match
* Medical, Dental and Eye Insurance
* Employee Referral Program
* Tuition Reimbursement
* Employee Assistance Program (EAP)
* Wellness Program
* Multiple Voluntary Medical Benefits

jobs.title: Meter Services Field Technician
jobs.description:
The South Adams County Water \& Sanitation District (SACWSD), dedicated to providing reliable, affordable and sustainable water resources and services to its customers, is seeking an individual to join the Meter Services Department.

  

This position provides customer service in the field related to water metering:

  

* Performs timely and accurate readings of District water meters
* Responds to customer questions, inquiries and issues in the field
* Turns on/off water service as needed
* Provides metering troubleshooting
* Provides minor maintenance, repair and replacement of meters, dials and valves
* Prepares work orders for maintenance department for larger repairs
* Investigates and troubleshoots leak data on customer water consumption

  

Qualified candidates should have a High School Diploma OR equivalent combination of education and experience. Mechanical aptitude necessary. Meter, valve and/or water distribution system experience helpful. Valid, current CO Driver’s License is required.

  

Proficient computer skills including Excel and Outlook. Strong problem solving, organizational and communication skills required. Self\-starter, with the ability to work independently as well as in a team environment.

  

The District offers a comprehensive benefits package including 100% medical paid with participation in and meeting wellness goal, dental, vision, basic life, disability, paid time off (PTO), paid holidays, money purchase pension plan, 457 savings plan, pet insurance, Employee Assistance Plan (EAP) and a variety of discount partners.

  

Salary range Level I/II: $20\.86–$33\.86/hr

  

The successful candidate will be required to complete a drug screen and background check prior to employment.

  

Application Deadline: August 17, 2026

 **Visit** **https://jobs.southadamswaterco.gov/** **to submit a resume**
